objective: Integrate the reviewable eight-layer controller PCB with the fail-closed chassis traction, wheel, battery, and replaceable motor-driver childboard engineering package.
acceptance: the detailed controller schematic, eight-layer board, controlled stackup, routed session, fabrication outputs, and connectivity/layout reports are reproducible
the controller keeps procurement, safety, supplier, and physical bring-up gates fail-closed
J2 contact capability is separated from the controlled 10 A aggregate system limit and U2 remains explicitly DNP until its approved MPN and land pattern ECO
CAN testpoint branches are machine-checked for short same-layer paired geometry while U7 system-isolation suitability remains release-blocking
the chassis package declares four wheel envelopes, two traction motor envelopes, a battery reservation, motor brackets, and a serviceable childboard support
the traction package distinguishes chassis motors from the six vendor-controlled UR5e joints and preserves independent hardware safety gating
motor, wheel, battery, isolated-power, regeneration, thermal, harness, DFM, and physical validation unknowns are not promoted to approved selections
deterministic hardware tests and release-readiness checks pass without modifying firmware, robot control, or shared interfaces
stop_conditions: an approved orderable MPN, AVL, datasheet revision, or land pattern is missing
regenerative energy lacks an approved clamp and absorption path
a safety output could be created by software alone
KiCad, connectivity, layout, mechanical, motor-package, or release-readiness validation fails
supplier DFM, calibrated physical measurements, safety approval, or prototype bring-up is required
